today.h: The Blue Wave Broke the War Trade: Dow +1,569, Brent -8.7%, the 10Y at 4.90%
today.d: Democrats won the House and Senate, oil settled 8.67% lower at $94.62 on hopes the Iran war ends, and the 10Y fell 5bp to 4.90% as the Dow rose 3.03% to 53,356.12 — while chips fell 3.14% and data-center suppliers lost 9% to 14%.
today.c1: A blue wave, repriced in six and a half hours. The S&P 500 opened at 7,635.81, never traded below that level, peaked at 7,715.57 at 1:07 p.m. and closed 119.70 points or 1.58% higher at 7,688.62 — its best session since 8/4. The Dow added 1,569.40 points or 3.03% to 53,356.12, its best day since April 2025 and its fifth-largest one-day point gain, with only Nvidia, Chevron and Caterpillar lower among its 30 members. The Nasdaq rose 1.44% to 25,736.51. The chain was political: Democrats took the House and Senate, the market read the result as an end to the Iran war's oil premium and a check on tariffs and spending, and Brent settled $8.98 or 8.67% lower at $94.62 — its lowest since Aug 31 — with WTI $7.97 or 8.29% lower at $88.12. That took the inflation premium out of the curve: the 10Y par yield fell 5bp to 4.90%, its lowest close since 9/9, the 30Y 4bp to 5.28% and the 2Y 3bp to 4.58%. The VIX fell 20.26% to 16.61.
today.c4:
• The breadth tell: the equal-weight RSP rose 1.86% against SPY's 1.65%, so the advance was broad — the leadership simply moved from AI hardware to the rate-sensitive half of the market.
  • The oil tell: Brent's $94.62 settle is 8.67% below Tuesday and back to Aug 31 levels; the war premium, not supply, was the asset being sold.
  • The AI tell: the losses sat in the picks and shovels (Vertiv and Vistra fell 12% to 14%) while Microsoft, Amazon and Apple rose and Microsoft and Apple closed at records — one ballot, two opposite AI trades.
  • The gates: October payrolls 11/6, CPI 11/10, the 10-year auction 11/10 and the 30-year 11/12, then the FOMC 12/8-9 with a hike about 83% priced.

chains.d: A midterm result that put Congress in Democratic hands was traded as the end of the war premium: crude -8.67%, the 10Y -5bp, the VIX -20.26% and the Dow +3.03%.

chains.t: ④ The Refunding Held Sizes, the Dollar Broke and Gold Had Its Best Day Since August
steps: ADP private payrolls rose 86,000 against a 75,000 consensus and ISM services held at 54.5 with prices at 73.0 — neither argued for lower yields
Treasury's quarterly refunding offered $125 billion to refund $97 billion and raise about $28 billion of new cash, keeping coupon sizes unchanged for several quarters
The auctions land 11/9 ($58 billion 3-year), 11/10 ($42 billion 10-year) and 11/12 ($25 billion 30-year)
The dollar index fell 0.34% to 101.53, a one-month low
December gold settled 3.37% higher at $4,073 after spot reclaimed $4,000, up from $3,869.85 on 10/30
A December rate increase was still about 83% priced on CME FedWatch, so the bid came from oil and politics rather than the Fed
chains.d: The refunding removed supply risk and the dollar broke, which is why gold had its best day since mid-August even with a hike still priced.
